cards.title: MIDD Reporting: MAP and MAR Requirements
cards.claim: Model Analysis Plans (MAP) should be pre-defined before data access/analysis. Model Analysis Reports (MAR) must document results, evaluation against technical criteria, and deviations from the MAP. All supporting data, code, and definition files must be available for regulatory review.
conditions: MAPs define planned evaluation activities and technical criteria
MARs include executive summary, objectives, data/methods, results, and discussion
Changes to planned analyses must be justified and documented
required_inputs: Pre-defined MAP with objectives and methods
MAR with detailed results and evaluation against technical criteria
limitations: Structure can be adjusted to specific M&S methods
Does not specify file formats for code/data beyond 'available for review'
cards.downstream_use: Structuring the final deliverables and ensuring traceability of the PK/PD analysis from planning to final report.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
